name: Fusion Tech Integrated
old_description: Fusion Tech designed an impressive adjustable floor stand that met our needs for durability, sanitation, and a cleanable non-slip surface. These stands have endured a 2 shift operation since 2008 and are still in great condition.
about:
Fusion Tech Integrated was founded in 2008 in Roseville, Illinois, as a small fabrication shop operating out of a two-car garage. The family-owned business is led by President and Owner Kathy Bentz, Vice President of Engineering and Owner Brandon Bentz, and After Sales Manager Dan Bentz. From those garage beginnings, the company has grown into a globally recognized brand serving some of the largest food processing companies while maintaining its original hands-on culture.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom food processing equipment and complete line solutions. Its capabilities span custom equipment design, 3D modeling, CNC machining, forming, welding, and a UL-certified panel shop for control systems. Fusion Tech manufactures ovens, shredders (SH-1, SH-5, SH-50), slicers, smokehouses, conveyors, platforms, and ergonomic handling tools such as the PushPal. With a 22-person team, the shop handles projects from single machines to multi-million-dollar plant expansions, including integration of OEM equipment and turnkey installation with training.

Fusion Tech serves the food processing industry, with a focus on meat, poultry, and prepared foods. Customers range from local butcher shops to large corporations such as Handtmann, Deli Star, and the Gaylord Opryland resort commissary. Testimonials highlight projects for beef trim processing, sausage and jerky production, and high-volume rack handling in facilities running multiple shifts.

The company emphasizes a family-owned, solution-based philosophy: “Make our partners better by providing innovative solutions.” It differentiates itself through in-house fabrication for quality and schedule control, 3D modeling for pre-production approval, and long-term technical support after installation.
